scope: Enforce the 7F.1b typed-result invariant that inputRead and outputReadback envelopes cannot exchange phase identity, including notApplicable routes.

implementation.change: _validate_observations now requires the inputRead-position envelope to declare inputRead and outputReadback-position envelope to declare outputReadback before applying route-specific availability rules.
implementation.gap: Available DWG read observations had route-specific phase checks, but notApplicable envelopes on DXF and write-recipe routes could carry the opposite phase label and still validate.
tests: A valid DXF schema-3 result with inputRead.phase mutated to outputReadback is rejected with an inputRead role error.
A valid DXF schema-3 result with outputReadback.phase mutated to inputRead is rejected with an outputReadback role error.
